paragraphs: I'm a Full-Stack Developer with around three years of experience in web development, passionate about creating modern, scalable, and user-focused digital solutions.

I specialize in building responsive and interactive web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, while developing backend solutions with NestJS, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and GraphQL. I also enjoy working with headless CMS architectures to create flexible and maintainable applications.

My approach to development focuses on clean architecture, performance, accessibility, and maintainable code. I enjoy solving complex problems, exploring emerging technologies, and transforming ideas into meaningful digital experiences.
Driven by curiosity and continuous learning, I'm always looking for opportunities to grow, collaborate, and build impactful software that delivers real value.

details: Studied software engineering with a focus on software development, programming, problem-solving, and practical technology projects, building a strong foundation in modern software engineering.
Pursued specialized training in full-stack development, focusing on frontend and backend technologies, web application development, and practical software development skills.
Completed secondary education, establishing an academic foundation for pursuing higher education in software engineering and technology.

cashcompass.summary: A personal finance web app that brings accounts, spending, budgets, savings goals and recurring payments into one view, forecasts what is coming next and exports PDF reports, in English and Khmer.
cashcompass.description: CashCompass answers three questions: where your money is, where it went and what is coming next. It brings accounts together, records income, expenses and transfers, and tracks budgets, savings goals and recurring payments. A calendar and a 30 to 90 day forecast show upcoming entries and the projected balance, and reports download as PDF. It works in English and Khmer with seven currencies. A demo runs on fictional data in the browser, and account mode is built on Supabase with Row Level Security.
highlights: Budgets, savings goals and recurring payments
30 to 90 day cash flow forecast and calendar
Seven currencies, English and Khmer, PDF reports

objectives: Show where money is, where it went and what is coming
Keep results exact across currencies and over time
Keep records private and let anyone try the app without signing up
study.problem: Money spread over cash, banks, cards and wallets in two currencies is hard to follow, simple trackers do not show upcoming payments, and converting old amounts at today's rate changes history.
study.solution: A web app that records every movement once, calculates balances from those records, converts each amount with the rate for its date and projects future balances from scheduled payments.
role: Application design and development with Nuxt, Vue and TypeScript
Financial rules, forecasting and PDF reports
Supabase schema, Row Level Security and server API routes
study.architecture: Nuxt, Vue and Pinia with one repository interface for the browser demo and the account API. Nitro routes check the session, validate input with Zod and use the signed-in user's Supabase client, so Row Level Security enforces ownership. Financial rules are shared by browser, server and tests.
challenges: Exact money: decimal arithmetic instead of floating point
Rate history: convert each entry with the rate for its date
Recurring payments: database locking and unique occurrences
Khmer PDF output: HarfBuzz text shaping in the browser

resumecraft.description: Build resumes and cover letters that stay in your browser. Choose from 12 resume and 3 letter templates, edit with a live preview in English or Khmer, and export to PDF or Word. Optional Gemini suggestions wait for your approval.
highlights: Live preview with PDF and Word export

objectives: Make a polished resume without an account or a database
Keep the preview and the exported PDF the same, including Khmer
Offer AI help that never changes a document on its own
study.problem: Resume builders often ask for an account, store personal data on their servers or charge for export, and Khmer text breaks in some PDF libraries.
study.solution: A local-first web app: the browser reads, renders, saves and exports documents, and the server is used only for AI requests.
role: Application design and development with Next.js and TypeScript
Server routes for the optional Gemini features
study.architecture: Next.js and React, with a Zustand editor store saved to IndexedDB through Dexie. One HTML renderer drives previews and printing. Route handlers keep the Gemini key on the server and validate every request and response.
challenges: Khmer PDF output: export through the browser's print engine
Matching page breaks: measure content blocks and place them on fixed pages
Tab conflicts: detect them and ask which copy to keep
Invented AI facts: check responses and require review before applying
